criteria.statement: CommandReceipt DTO exposes request_event_id, status/result kinds, and idempotency_key.
Publish-and-wait defaults to 30 seconds and distinguishes no-relay acceptance from post-acceptance/partial failure.
Idempotency keys are represented as Nostr d tags and reactor/persistence support replay detection by kind, pubkey, and d tag.
REST Nostr-backed long-running writes return 202 with canonical receipt shape without breaking known synchronous frontend compatibility routes.
MCP deployment and rollback use the canonical service command publisher when configured and return uniform receipt fields.
CLI signer-first operator requests generate deterministic idempotency keys and apply a 30 second default publish-and-wait timeout.
Normative docs describe command receipt and idempotency semantics.
